description: The SKMEI Zikr Smart Ring is a revolutionary digital tasbeeh designed to complement your Islamic prayers and lifestyle. Compact and versatile and this smart ring is not just a tasbeeh counter but also a stylish and practical beautiful accessory. With features like Bluetooth connectivity and waterproof and a long-lasting rechargeable battery aprox 3 days, the Zikr Smart Ring is your ultimate companion for daily prayer and mindfulness.
